label: Weather
description: Weather conditions layered over any scene.

items.name: clear-sky
items.text: crystal-clear sky, crisp visibility to the horizon

items.name: dramatic-clouds
items.text: towering dramatic cumulus clouds, patches of light moving across the ground

items.name: overcast
items.text: flat overcast sky, soft shadowless grey light

items.name: light-rain
items.text: light steady rain, glistening surfaces and fine droplets caught in the light

items.name: downpour
items.text: torrential downpour, sheets of rain, water streaming and splashing off every surface

items.name: thunderstorm
items.text: a brooding thunderstorm, lightning forking through charcoal clouds

items.name: ground-fog
items.text: low ground fog pooling knee-deep, shapes fading with distance

items.name: dense-mist
items.text: dense enveloping mist, the world reduced to soft layered silhouettes

items.name: snowfall
items.text: quiet steady snowfall, fat flakes drifting, fresh powder muffling every edge

items.name: blizzard
items.text: horizontal wind-driven blizzard, whiteout gusts and streaking snow

items.name: heat-haze
items.text: shimmering heat haze rising from the ground, wavering mirage distortion

items.name: after-the-rain
items.text: freshly rained-out air, puddled reflections, drips falling from edges under a clearing sky
